_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Logistic Support Analysis Record (LSAR) Pricing Plan
summary: This DID is used by the contractor to establish LSAR prices for "P" source-coded items, provide verifiable price input, and support Government monitoring of the contractor's LSAR pricing efforts.
description_purpose:
3.1 The contractor prepared and Government approved LSAR Pricing Plan is used by the contractor to establish LSAR prices for all "P" source-coded items and to provide for consistent verifiable contractor price input.
3.2 The approved LSAR Pricing Plan is used to monitor and evaluate the contractor's LSAR pricing efforts.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 The contract should require the submission of a draft LSAR Pricing Plan for Government review and approval.
7.3 The approved LSAR Pricing Plan is related to other contractor plans e.g. Integrated Support Plan (ISP) and Logistic Support Analysis (LSA) Plan.
7.4 This Data Item Description supersedes DI-L-1425.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Logistic Support Analysis Record (LSAR) Pricing Plan shall be organized into three major sections. The LSAR Pricing Plan shall be typed or printed on white bond paper. Pages shall be 8 1/2 by 11 inches and shall be punched suitable for binding in a three-ring loose leaf binder.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The LSAR Pricing Plan shall consist of three major sections in accordance with the following instructions:

children.title: Section 1. - General.
children.content: This section shall contain the following:

children.title: Purpose and Scope.
children.content: A concise statement of the scope and intended purpose.

children.title: Updating Process.
children.content: A description of how changes and revisions of the date will be developed, approved, and incorporated.

children.title: Summary.
children.content: A concise description sufficient to establish a clear understanding of the total scope and content of the material presented.

children.title: Section 2. - Pricing Methodology.
children.content: This section shall provide a description of the contractor methodology for determining unit of measure prices for "P" source-coded item(s) to be entered into the LSAR data base. The contractor methodology shall include the following:

children.title: Pricing of purchase finished or manufactured part(s).
Pricing of combination purchase or in-house manufactured part(s).
Prices.
children.content: The pricing data shall be sub-divided to address prices as follows:

children.title: "Prices" - Cited in the Defense Logistics Services Center (DLSC) files.
"Prices" - When no NSN is contained in the DLSC files.
Computation.
children.content: The unit of measure prices shall be based on the most economical of the following:

children.title: Contractor's recommended one year's initial support.
Section 3. - LSAR Pricing Plan, Management, and Execution.
children.content: This section shall provide a complete description of the overall process that will be used in managing and executing the LSAR Pricing Plan including both the required Government and contractor participation.
